title: RecommendationSystem RecSysV2LaunchEvaluation

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the RecSys v2 launch evaluation research task. Conducted comprehensive analysis of offline evaluation metrics (n=200,000) and online A/B test results (14-day, 10% traffic per arm). Generated statistical analysis, business impact assessment, risk evaluation, and multiple visualizations. Produced final research report with clear recommendation: DO NOT LAUNCH RecSys v2 due to critical 187% increase in complaint rate indicating serious user experience issues. All deliverables including code, outputs, figures, and report are complete.
